description: Runs the site's AI Readiness Assessment. Call it with no answers to get the 10 questions and their scored options; ask the user; then call it again with one score (1 to 4) per question in order to get the level (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced), the percent score, the per-dimension breakdown, the weakest dimensions and service recommendations.

answers.description: One score from 1 to 4 per question, in question order (10 questions). Omit to receive the questions.

name: assess_ai_readiness
title: Assess AI readiness
